about_short_description.short_description: Movella is a full-stack hardware and software firm specializing in movement digitization.

product.name: Xsens Motion Capture Systems
product.description: Wearable inertial motion-capture systems that record full-body movement for animation, biomechanics, ergonomics, sports analysis, and robotics.

product.name: Xsens Animate
product.description: Motion-capture software that converts inertial sensor data into real-time character animation for games, film, VFX, virtual production, streaming, and immersive applications.

product.name: Xsens Analyze
product.description: Biomechanical motion-analysis software for visualizing, recording, and evaluating human movement in sports, research, rehabilitation, and occupational ergonomics.

product.name: Xsens Sensor Modules
product.description: Industrial MEMS-based IMU, AHRS, GNSS/INS, RTK, and vision-aided navigation modules that provide 3D orientation, position, velocity, and motion data.

product.name: Xsens Humanoid
product.description: Motion-training software and hardware for teleoperating, simulating, developing, and training humanoid robots using captured human movement.

product.name: Xsens Ergo Live
product.description: A workplace-ergonomics solution combining Xsens Awinda and Xsens Analyze for real-time posture assessment, load calculations, and Excel-based reporting.
